name: How long does it take to complete a home addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a home addition depends on its scope and complexity. Smaller additions might take a few months, while larger or more intricate projects could extend to six months or more. We provide a projected timeline during the planning phase, keeping you informed of progress and any potential adjustments.
